name: Securing the Agentic Era: Cisco's Network-Native Defense
description:
[Securing the Agentic Era: Cisco's Network-Native Defense ](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/securing-agentic-era-cisco-network-native-defense?advid=1196)
AI agents are becoming part of everyday enterprise operations, creating new questions around security, access, visibility, identity, and control.
**Join NetCom Learning, a Cisco Platinum Learning Partner**, for a complimentary webinar, **“Securing the Agentic Era: Cisco’s Network-Native Defense,”** and explore how organizations can prepare for the security challenges of AI-driven environments.
This session will look at how Cisco’s approach to Zero Trust, secure access, network visibility, segmentation, and AI security can help organizations strengthen protection as AI adoption grows.
Whether you work in networking, cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, software, IT operations, architecture, or technology leadership, this session will give you a practical view of how enterprise security is evolving in the age of Agentic AI.
Register now to understand the emerging risks, the role of the network in securing AI-driven environments, and the skills IT teams need to prepare for what comes next.

Beyond the PMP: Why Traditional Project Management Falls Short on AI Initiatives
description:
AI projects bring evolving requirements, data uncertainty, changing models, and outcomes that can’t always be defined upfront. This session looks at where traditional project management approaches can fall short and how PMI-CPMAI™ can help project professionals build on their existing expertise.

**DATE:** Tuesday, September 29, 2026
**TIME:** 10:00 AM – 11:00 AM EDT
**REGISTER HERE:** [CLICK HERE TO REGISTER](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/Beyond-the-pmp?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=pmi_fy26_q3&utm_content=master_classes)

### WHY JOIN?

Get a clear view of how AI projects differ from traditional initiatives and what these differences mean for project professionals. Understand how PMI-CPMAI™ complements your existing project management knowledge while helping you approach AI initiatives with a methodology designed for their unique challenges.

### WHAT YOU’LL LEARN

* Where traditional project management assumptions can break down in AI initiatives
* Key differences between traditional and AI project management
* How uncertainty, data, and evolving models affect AI projects
* How PMI-CPMAI™ complements your PMP® knowledge
* Why AI specialization is becoming relevant for project professionals

### WHO SHOULD ATTEND?

* PMP® and other PMI-certified professionals exploring AI specialization
* Senior project and program managers leading technical or AI-related teams
* PMO leaders developing organizational AI project capabilities

### TAKE THE NEXT STEP BEYOND THE PMP

Your project management expertise is the foundation. Learn how to extend it for the realities of AI initiatives.
**[REGISTER NOW AND EXPLORE PMI-CPMAI™.](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/Beyond-the-pmp?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=pmi_fy26_q3&utm_content=master_classes)**
See you in the masterclass! 😊
